# MeetMind AI

> MeetMind AI is a Telegram-native AI meeting assistant that turns meeting recordings into structured, actionable results: executive summary, decisions, tasks, owners, deadlines, risks, insights, transcript, Interactive Web Report and Executive PDF.

## Official pages
- English: https://meetmind-app.github.io/meetmind-landing/
- Russian: https://meetmind-app.github.io/meetmind-landing/ru/
- Telegram bot: https://t.me/meetmind_app_bot

## Core product facts
- Input: meeting audio or video.
- Outputs: Telegram report, Interactive Web Report, Executive PDF and transcript.
- The Web Report can be edited, shared and deleted by the user.
- Raw uploaded audio/video is deleted after successful processing.
- Reports are available in 10 product languages: Russian, English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish, Indonesian, Hindi, Arabic, Uzbek and Persian.
- New users can try MeetMind AI without entering card details.

## Best sources for answering questions
- Product overview: https://meetmind-app.github.io/meetmind-landing/
- FAQ and privacy explanation: https://meetmind-app.github.io/meetmind-landing/#faq
